title: Long Steel
description:
Long Steel is an action-adventure RPG that challenges the player through vicious monster encounters and massive dungeons. As you embark on your quest, you will find many items to unlock new paths and come face to face with puzzles, obstacles and treacherous dungeon bosses. Slice, shoot and cast magic spells to pave your way through the punishing landscapes. Cooking food, alchemizing potions and crafting new weapons will aid you on your journey. Complete side quests and explore the world to find items that will make you strong enough to cut down any foe that dares to cross your path! 

 
In the Grand Archipelago, sits the island of Melas. Once the beating heart of the world, this island now serves as a grim reminder of a world nearly torn asunder by the nefarious Shaper of Magic, Warlock. Twenty years have passed since Warlock was defeated and sealed away, and now his heinous worshippers seek to resurrect him from his ashes. Now you may be all that stands in the way between the Wicken Cult and the end of the world as we know it.

• Travel through diverse landscapes 

• Fight your way through 9 dungeons  and various mini dungeons

• Meet over a hundred NPCS

• Cook, Smith, and Alchemize equipment, weapons, potions and food

• Complete lots of side quests

• Level to 30, increasing your health, mana and stamina as you go

• Find upgrades to make you stronger and more durable

• Lots of hidden secrets and easter eggs!

• And lots more!

 

Keyboard • Controller 

•Pause: D Key • Left Bumper 

•Attack/Save: C Key • Right Button 

•Action: Space bar • Bottom Button 

•Item keys: X and V Keys • Left and Top Buttons 

•Movement: Arrow Keys • Left Joystick 

Long Steel is created with the Solarus Game Engine, a free, open-source game engine.
description_short: Slash, shoot and craft your way through vicious monsters and perilous dungeons in this post apocalyptic quest to save the world.
